title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode3 Special Coaching

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Line: A few days later
COL

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Oh, you both made it over.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry we're late.
Our event went on longer than expected, and we got caught up in traffic.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's so nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really need to thank you for opening your live house today just for me.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I was pretty surprised when Ken said that he wanted to use this place for training. But I feel a lot better after seeing your smiling face.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, why does she get the royal treatment and not me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(COL...
Where Nagi and her team held RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't believe that I get to train here.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I should be able to get a good sense of what she and her team felt as they sang here.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So...
Where is this special coach that you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, they should be here soon.
You wouldn't think so from the look of them, but they like to be punctual.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That must be them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'm hearing a lot of footsteps...
It's more than just one person?)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Oh, you guys already got everything set up. And it's great to see that you're still alive, Granny.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Is this Taiga's prized pupil?
It's great that we finally get to meet her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
W-Wait a second, they're...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next, we have RUST!
They're all yours!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You all performed during RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member B
rows.Line:
Oh, you recognize us?!
Thanks for remembering!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: Haha! RADder sort of dominated everyone's minds, so people sometimes forget that we were also there.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
You guys are way more famous now. Not a day goes by without me hearing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, these guys are going to be your special coaches.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What...?!
But they were such an integral part of RAD WEEKEND! Are you sure about this...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you all very much for doing this...! But you must be very busy people...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, we are pretty busy, but Ken made a personal request.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: He asked, “Some kids want to see what lies beyond Nagi's dream, so would you mind giving them a hand?”

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: We sorta couldn't refuse after hearing that.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: We were able to grant Nagi's request for one last event...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: But we've never done anything about her other last request. Helping the next generation carry her dream forward, that is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They also want to help fulfill Nagi's final wishes.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm looking forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My goal—our goal—is to take Nagi's dream and carry it forward! Until we're standing on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, please help me become strong enough to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What did I tell you?
See that look in her eye?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, you were right...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: She's serious... And all fired up.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start explaining what we're gonna have you do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Y-Yes, please do!!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
There's no need to be so formal.
I know you're training, but this is still meant to be fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fun...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Originally, this was a game that we liked to play.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
The rules are simple.
We'll play some music and take turns singing a few bars each, freestyle.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We'll repeat that until it's finished, and the person who did best will be declared the winner. We'll all act as the judges.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
RADder was always so good at this.
You guys won basically every time we played.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: But we managed to snag a few wins along the way. I mean, everyone here usually puts up a good fight.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: I mean, we wouldn't be here otherwise.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
So, first...
You need to become strong enough to defeat us.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Otherwise, you'll never be able to surpass the energy of that night. Not even for one second.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, understood...!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear.
That being said... Winning consistently against these guys is unbelievably difficult.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, your goal will be to beat each of them one time. If you do, then you'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All of these guys were basically on the same level as Nagi. If you can defeat them, then your chances of blasting a hole in that moment will increase significantly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to beat people who were on the same level as Nagi...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to singing with all of you!!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Alright... Let's get started.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: ♪ーーーー!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
He's singing off the cuff, but he still sounds incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I'm supposed to defeat all of them...?!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Hey, not bad...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Then, lemme kick it up a notch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, that sort of felt like...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's how I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, don't get overwhelmed...!
You need to try to win!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ♪...ーーーーーーーー!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You sounded pretty amazing, but this first bout's a loss for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
You still did really well.
I'm looking forward to seeing how you grow from here.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Although, you definitely weren't singing at a hundred percent. I'd say around fifty. You totally pulled your punches back there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: I didn't want to take it seriously before giving my throat a chance to warm up. I won't hold back next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He held back... That wasn't everything he had...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is so frustrating...
I don't stand a chance against them at my current level...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But wallowing in my frustration isn't going to solve anything.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to keep growing.
I have to get stronger...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!!)
Two weeks later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, your breathing is pretty ragged.
Wanna take a break soon?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm okay!
I can keep going!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
You sure?
Then, let's go another round.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's already been two weeks.
We've been doing this for two hours every single day, but...)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: ♪ーーーー!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I can't win...!
I can't even imagine myself beating them...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, I'm never going to make any progress...!!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Focus... You need to focus more...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Think back.
How did it feel when you sang with everything you had...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That time, I...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I took what all the locals were feeling and sang in a way that resonated with them.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then, all I have to do now is remind myself of our resolve and express that by singing...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー~~~~~!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That still isn't enough...?!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: I thought I saw something there for a moment... But, I guess you're still not there yet.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: If you can take what you just did in that moment and replicate it a hundred times, then you might be able to eke out one win.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You don't have time to be feeling bad about yourself.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Because that night was nothing like what we're doing here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!!
